title: fix(cli): settle plugin admissions before shared-state close
body:
## Summary
- make one-shot CLI plugin-cache retirement wait for timed-out plugin tails
- prevent native admission publication from outliving shared-state shutdown
- cover the required settlement option with a focused lifecycle test

## Release evidence
FRV 41215122210 macOS installer-fresh and packaged-fresh both failed deterministically after onboarding left SQLite offline maintenance owned by the exiting CLI process. The packaged lane also logged `Plugin source receipt was not recorded: Error: Database maintenance resource scope is closed`. The CLI currently retires operation caches with bounded settlement, allowing native admission cleanup to continue after `withCliCommandCleanup` closes shared state.

## Validation
- `pnpm exec vitest run src/cli/run-main-plugin-cache.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:test:root`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/cli/run-main-plugin-cache.ts src/cli/run-main-plugin-cache.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

Release blocker for 2026.11.1-beta.1; publication remains forbidden.
